answer: Exactly the Open Ambiguities item 'Owner decision, handling'; C is recommended there, but only the owner can pick A/B/C, so the task is correctly status: blocked.
Exactly the Open Ambiguities item 'Owner decision, marker'; `record: true` is recommended but not decided, so no schema work can start.

No IssueDoc model (deskops/models/__init__.py lists none), but drawer issues already use plain frontmatter: desk/drawer/issues/issue-sldb-viewer-monolithic-api-anti-pattern.md:1-5 is a leading `---` YAML block (title/date/status). Extractors ignore unknown keys, so adding `record: true` that way is safe.
Option C needs output/exit-code changes in _graph_missing (deskops/cli/main.py:296-309), yet main.py is not in files:. Fix: add deskops/cli/main.py to files: (and Scope) as an in-scope edit.

files: is edit scope; test_graph_cli.py needs no change. Its only missing-finding test uses a non-record path (docs/guide.md) and still expects exit 1 (tests/test_graph_cli.py:197-215), which Option C preserves.

Findings are computed live each run: find_missing_graph_references calls extract_declared_edges(root) (deskops/graph/checks.py:32-34), and main.py:289 passes graph_path=None unless --graph is given. No graph build/cache is needed for --root .

All graph-missing output goes to stdout via print() (deskops/cli/main.py:300-309); tests assert captured.out (tests/test_graph_cli.py:213). The heading text, position, and summary string are already fixed by the task.

Goal says 'every drawer document marked as a record', while 'one general rule (no per-file allowlist)' implies marker-anywhere. Fix: state explicitly that the marker is checked on any extracted doc, or restrict detection to desk/drawer/**.

Option C is kind-agnostic: any finding whose source doc is a record is informational and not failure-counted. The 'other finding kinds' out-of-scope note only excludes fixing those kinds, not their record handling.

Missing targets never become edges: snapshots use only edge_result.edges (deskops/graph/snapshot.py:74-83) and findings come from missing_targets (checks.py:34). Suppressing record findings changes only finding consumers, not the edge index.

Both pills exist in-repo: desk/contexts/pill-009-source-file-graph-traceability.md and desk/contexts/pill-010-graph-runtime-output-policy.md. Nothing in the planned record-marker/extraction handling contradicts them.

The 99-finding set is asserted, not verified; any non-record dangling path at HEAD makes 'exits 0 on the repo desk' unreachable. Fix: record the full HEAD finding list with provenance in the task before relying on the before/after delta.

Done When requires only 'both new tests pass' while Validation requires full pytest tests. Fix: make Done When require the full suite green (AGENTS.md minimum), or narrow Validation to the two named files.
